weather.title: Weather
weather.noAlerts: No weather warnings. Good conditions for farm work.

alert.heavy_rain: Heavy rain of about {{rain_mm}} mm expected. Clear field drains; postpone spraying and fertilizer.
alert.very_heavy_rain: Very heavy rain of about {{rain_mm}} mm expected. Protect harvested produce, clear drains, keep animals safe.
alert.heat_stress: Very hot day, up to {{temp_c}}°C. Irrigate in the evening or early morning.
alert.cold_stress: Cold night, down to {{temp_c}}°C. Light evening irrigation protects crops from frost.
alert.avoid_spraying_rain: Rain is likely today. Do not spray pesticide or fertilizer; it may wash off.
alert.avoid_spraying_wind: Strong wind today (about {{wind_kmh}} km/h). Avoid spraying.
alert.dry_spell: No rain expected for {{days}} days. Plan irrigation.
alert.delay_fertilizer: Rain is forecast when your fertilizer is due. Consider delaying it by a day or two.

market.title: Market prices
market.noData: No recent price for this crop in your state.
market.stale: The market service is slow — showing the last saved prices.
market.notForecast: These are real prices seen in mandis, not a forecast.

cropAdvice.title: Which crop should I grow?
cropAdvice.intro: We use your soil test and your local weather.
cropAdvice.needSoil: Add your soil test first — it is on your Soil Health Card.
cropAdvice.rangeWarning: Some soil values are outside what the model learned from. Use this advice with care.

reason.water_risk: Needs more water than rain gives
reason.rotation: Same as your last crop — rotate
reason.uncommon_in_region: Not commonly grown in your state
reason.needs_hills: Grows only in the hills (higher altitude)

diagnose.diseaseIntro: Take a clear photo of one affected leaf in daylight.
diagnose.pestIntro: Take a clear photo of the insect or the damaged part.
diagnose.uncertain: Not sure — please take a clearer photo
diagnose.unverified: Awaiting expert review. Confirm with your agriculture officer before spraying.
diagnose.notTranslated: Some advice is shown in English until a translation is available.
diagnose.cameraPermission: Please allow the camera to take a photo.

schemes.title: Government schemes

schemes.notTranslated: Details are shown in English until a translation is available.

calendar.title: Farm calendar
calendar.empty: Add a crop with its sowing date to get your farm tasks.

profit.intro: Enter your expected harvest, price and costs.
